dialogue.name: Cio

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good...

dialogue.speech: Well done, Secco!

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: The more curious someone is, the stronger they become mentally.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Humans are far more curious than any other creature, and that's why they evolved.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: I can't wait to see it...

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: I can't wait to see guys like him die.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Oh, right. Forgive me, I'd forgotten.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: You get a treat for taking such a good picture.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: How does two sound?

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Three, you say? You want three sweet ones?

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: You little glutton.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: All right. You can have three.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Here it comes, Secco. Here comes three!

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Oh, my bad.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Good!

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good...

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: You're such a good boy, Secco!

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Now, go!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What are we going to do, Bucciarati?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: We can't go back out to sea.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: If that mold's range is extended by the corpses, as Giorno guessed,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: then instead of tracking down the user,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: we're better off finding a car and getting out of this village.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Our number one priority right now is to get to Rome.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Giorno, how's Narancia's treatment going?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: It's hard to treat him in this village.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: There's living mold in his wounds.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: All right, Mista, climbing up is fine.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We're going to go up those stairs and get ourselves a car.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: That's a bit cruel, Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: He didn't even ask Narancia if he was okay or not.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Not to mention, earlier,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: when you were trying desperately to get up from the boat,

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: what did he say?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: He coldly ordered you to throw the turtle.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: What are you so mad about?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Of course he said that. I was the one who went down into the boat.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: It's good that we made it out alive, but because of me, we almost died.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Besides, if Bucciarati hadn't told me to throw the turtle,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I might've dropped it into the ocean.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I know that!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What I'm saying is that he's cold to everyone!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Say... I don't really understand how girls feel, but...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Were you hoping he would ask you if you were okay?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I already know how Bucciarati is,

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: but you're dying to know more about him.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Excuse me? I'm dying to what?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Well, getting to Rome is what's most important right now.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: You can figure out your feelings later.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I'm really not doing so great right now.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Let me rest for a bit.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: The only way we can go is up right now,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: but if we should ever have to go down any lower than where we are...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We'll be fine.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: This village is built on the side of a mountain.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: All the roads are uphill.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: And outside the village, there are cars still running.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That means the mold's range hasn't expanded yet.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We just need to acquire a car and get out of this village quickly.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We need to hurry to Rome at all costs.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Which car should we take?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: One with a corpse next to it, because that corpse should have the key to that car.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It was just the mold breaking that corpse's hand apart.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'll watch our rear.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You hurry up and get a car.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Right.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Mista, I take that back.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Something... Something is wrong.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Hurry and go up!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: R-Right!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: What are you doing, Mista?! I told you to go up!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I already am, Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: But...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: We're sinking!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: We're moving away from the wall!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: What's going on?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: The whole staircase is being pulled into the ground!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: This must be a different Stand user than the one using the mold!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: There's another one after us!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: This isn't good! We need to hurry and climb up!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: If we go down any further, the mold will attack us!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Jump onto the wall!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: My g*n!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's not sinking...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The staircase itself is sinking into the ground, like it's melting!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What's that?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The enemy!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The enemy's down below, and he's coming for us!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Mista! Climb onto the wall!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Zipper Man!

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&HC&\c&HDA&}Zu{\c&HB&}bo{\c&HBA&}om

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: He's fast... This guy is fast.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: And this is strange...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: The ground feels solid when I'mtouching it with Zipper Man's hands.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This is a solid stone staircase, but I'm sinking into it...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: And this thing is moving around freely underneath the hard ground.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This isn't good! I can't tell where he is!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Where is he coming from?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Can you hear me, Six b*ll*ts?!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Come back to me!

dialogue.name: B*ll*ts
dialogue.speech: Yee-haw!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: One coming at us from beneath the ground,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: and a man-eating mold Stand...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: They're both making the most of the other's Stand ability.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This duo is too compatible, more so than any other team we've encountered before.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What are they, bound by the red thread of fate? Damn it!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I found one, Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: A corpse that's still holding the car key.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: You b*stard!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I just caught a glimpse of our enemy!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He jumped from the stairs and dove into the wall!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Th-This is...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Run, Mista!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: It's fast! At this rate, we might make it to the car,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: but we won't have time to start the engine!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I'll hold them back! Keep going!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Don't stop, Mista! The ground is still hard!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The b*ll*ts are going to ricochet!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: If the sinking ground is still hard somehow,

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: our best chance is the moment I get pulled under.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: This guy's the powerful, close-range type.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: His range is small.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I should be able to see it as soon as it tries to pull me in.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: That's when I'll get him!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: There! It showed itself!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Now!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Take this!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Mista!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I see...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: I figured a powerful, close-range type might be able to deflect some b*ll*ts.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: But you see...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: If you're going to deflect b*ll*ts, my b*ll*ts can do that, too!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: The first three shots I fired should...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What?!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He's not going to finish me off?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: So he thinks he can k*ll me at any time, now that I'm hurt?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Hurry and pick up the key, Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Start the engine!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What the hell are you doing?! Hurry up and get in the car!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: If we can actually get out of this village by car, that's fine.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: As long as we can all head for Rome.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Where are you going, Bucciarati?!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Wh-What?!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: So you're going to track us from underground, no matter where we go?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: What a terrifying ability.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But do you have any idea where I'm headed?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Apparently you didn't, huh? You had no idea where we were.

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: My...

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: My...

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: My face!

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: What?

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Cioccolata!

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Three days ago... You heard, right?

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: The Stand that the boss sent into the airplane... Notorious Chase...

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Hey, Secco. Aren't you tracking them down right now?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Why are you calling me?

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Hey, Cioccolata... This is important. Very important!

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Chase... Is that thing...

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Is it alive? Or is it a dead Stand?

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: What brought this on?

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: It's a simple question!

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Answer me. If Chase was here,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: would your Green Tea's mold grow on it? On the dead Stand?

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Notorious Chase...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Are you talking about the one where the user was k*lled, but his hatred

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: was so strong that the Stand somehow survived?

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Who knows?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I'm curious about him, but I have no idea if the mold would grow on him.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: But I do know for certain that my Green Tea will destroy any living creature.

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: The mold doesn't grow on inanimate objects like rocks, right?

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Forget about that! Quit wasting time and film those guys dying already!

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: That's just it, though, Cioccolata!

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Look up the hill. Look at the road.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Hey, Secco...

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Why is there a car leaving the village?

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Is the one driving the car one of them?

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Why did you just let them go?

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Hey, Cioccolata... It's just unbelievable...

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: He hit me in the face.

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: That Bucciarati guy... He didn't have any mold growing on him.

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: Even though he jumped down!

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: I can't believe he attacked me there...

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: It's totally unbelievable!

dialogue.name: Secco
dialogue.speech: His body won't grow mold! What the hell is going on?!

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: I haven't the slightest.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I totally thought...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: that you had plummeted.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: You scared me, Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Did you hang on to the wall with zippers?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I guess it might've been a close call.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It doesn't look like the mold got you at all.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Mista, rest for a bit.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I closed your wounds, but if you move now, they'll start bleeding again.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I'll look out for any cars that might be following us.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Right...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, your wrist... Did you hurt it?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Please, let me see it.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Are you listening, Bucciarati?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: If the mold got to you, you're in danger.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Please, let me see it.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Th-That's impossible...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Your skin is so cold...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: A-And your pulse...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Giorno, did you just say something to me?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I couldn't hear you.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: What's... going on?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Impossible...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: It simply can't be!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: O-Oh, yeah... Something similar happened before.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I thought it was just my imagination back then...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: When we were leaving Venice.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Apparently, I hurt myself.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Looks like there isn't much time left.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm losing more and more feeling in my skin...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Or...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Maybe I never had any to begin with.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's impossible! Don't tell me, back then...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: When you saved Trish from the boss in Venice...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, don't tell me... back then...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's strange.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I've accepted this as fate.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Just a tiny bit of fate, of chance, that Heaven had granted me.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: When you healed my wounds in Venice,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: it appears the life force you gave me

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: allowed me to move for just a bit longer.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Why... Why didn't you say anything?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: My Golden Wind completely healed your wounds back then!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I'm sure it can fix whatever you're going through now, too!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Giorno, I'm sure your Golden Wind

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: knows more about that than anyone else.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That nothing can be done for those whose lives have already ended.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: By that time,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: my life...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: had already ended.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You won't tell the others about this, right?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's impossible... But that's impossible, Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Y-You're—

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Quiet, Giorno!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Listen. What's that sound? Am I just hearing things?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: There's no car following us.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I hear it. It's getting closer.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's getting really close!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: What?!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Above us! It's a helicopter!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: He dropped some mold on us!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Wh-What the hell just happened?!

dialogue.name: Giio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, we're descending! This road goes downhill!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: The mold is going to get us!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Giorno, Mista! We're jumping out!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Grab on to me!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Climb up! Climb up, even if only a little bit!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Subconscious...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: In a way, Stand abilities are the users' subconscious abilities...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: If there's any guilt in their heart,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: they might subconsciously hit the brakes...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: But whoever this is enjoys cruelty.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Actually, he lives for it.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That's how his ability became this.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This guy doesn't have any brakes at all!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: He has no limits on how evil he can be!

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Hey, what's wrong?! I-I'll go get a doctor right away!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Hey, don't! Don't go down that way!

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: I'll bring a doctor here right away!

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Hey, what's going on?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: The mold...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It's spreading instantaneously!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That's impossible. There are three million people living in Rome.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This is nothing like that fishing village!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: And there are members of the organization in Rome.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This would be a hit to the boss, too.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This guy doesn't care.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: He's enjoying this!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: At this rate, everyone in Rome will die!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: No, this guy's not going to stop, even if it spreads further than that!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: There's something else!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: At this rate, the mold's k*lling range will spread to the Colosseum

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: faster than we can get there.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Mista! Is that helicopter within your g*n's range?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It doesn't matter! We have to hit it, no matter what!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Make sure you take it down!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Got it! I won't let you get away!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Go, Six b*ll*ts!

dialogue.name: B*ll*ts
dialogue.speech: Yee-haw!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: The guy in the helicopter wanted me to shoot at it...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: So that the guy who can move around underground could safely get to us!

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: All right, Secco was able to splash down safely... or should I say land?

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: Now they're cornered.

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: And whoever Bucciarati and his men were meeting in Rome

dialogue.name: Cio
dialogue.speech: will be dealt with by Green Tea.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Th-That b*stard's coming from the top of the hill!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: And we can't go back down!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Mista, concentrate on the helicopter!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: We can't let it escape!
